captions.detailed: A tall, rectangular stone-finish campanile tower with a decorative base and a matching stepped overhanging cap. One side of the tower features a vertical rectangular channel running down its face, intended as a rope guide. The structure is rendered in a uniform matte gray-brown stone texture.
captions.instruction: Generate a tall rectangular stone campanile tower. The design must feature a decorative stepped base, a matching stepped top cap, and a vertical rope guide channel recessed on one of its side faces.
captions.factory: The code constructs the campanile as a single multi-part body using box primitives. First, the main tower shaft is created as a tall box. A vertical rectangular channel is cut from one face of the tower using a boolean cut operation. The base and the top cap are constructed from slightly wider, flat boxes stacked at the bottom and top of the main shaft to form the decorative stepped details.
